blurb: The center offers horseback riding lessons for all levels starting at age five, including private and group lessons year-round. They provide summer horseback riding camps for ages 6-12 with sessions in July. Clinics with guest instructors are held periodically, and a horsemanship challenge program is available for riders age 10 and up.
extraNote: No refunds given for partial lesson packages or membership · Summer camp deposit of $175 is non-refundable
